text: Before you ask Allah for more, ask this first.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said: My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me.
And Allah gave him the wind, blowing by his command, wherever he directed.
Before you ask for more today... ask Allah for forgiveness first. Then ask Him for anything.
